title: Toronto to Niagara Falls Half Day Private Tour Up To 4 People
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Many people visiting Niagara Falls from Toronto cannot spend the entire day visiting all the sites the Niagara region has to offer. 

Whether you need to catch a flight or just want to see the Falls and skip the other tour destinations a Half-Day Tour is for you.
Please Note: Customer pays for all entrance fees to any attractions visited.
With a custom tour the attractions you visit are completely up to you!
